description: Source code for RoadmapRepository class managing CRUD operations for Roadmap objects using SQLAlchemy ORM.

classes.name: RoadmapRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing persistence of Roadmap entities, including create, list, get, update, and delete operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Roadmap entry with validated fields and serializes the graph payload.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of Roadmaps, optionally filtered by user identifier.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a Roadmap by ID, optionally verifying ownership by user identifier.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates mutable fields of an existing Roadmap, including name, graph payload, and notes.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Roadmap from the database.
